<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden character</title>
<style>
html,body{width:240px;height:294px;margin:0;overflow:hidden}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true,antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const backdrop = document.createElement('canvas');
backdrop.width = 40;
backdrop.height = 48;
const ctx = backdrop.getContext('2d');
const bg = ctx.createImageData(40,48);
const stops = [[0,[210,207,199]],[.14,[227,228,224]],[.34,[250,250,247]],[.63,[255,255,253]],[.77,[244,245,240]],[1,[171,170,166]]];
for(let j=0;j<48;j++){
  const y=j/47;
  let k=1;
  while(y>stops[k][0]) k++;
  const blend=(y-stops[k-1][0])/(stops[k][0]-stops[k-1][0]);
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const x=i/39;
    const glow=5*Math.exp(-((x-.08)**2/.028+(y-.51)**2/.10));
    const corner=4*x*Math.cos(y*6);
    for(let c=0;c<3;c++) bg.data[4*(j*40+i)+c]=stops[k-1][1][c]*(1-blend)+stops[k][1][c]*blend+glow-corner;
    bg.data[4*(j*40+i)+3]=255;
  }
}
ctx.putImageData(bg,0,0);
scene.background = new THREE.CanvasTexture(backdrop);
scene.background.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.4,2.4,2.94,-2.94,.1,60);
ref.position.set(0,2.94,14);
ref.lookAt(0,2.94,0);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffcf0,0xc0aa82,1.55));
function light(color,intensity,x,y,z){
  const lamp=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  lamp.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(lamp);
}
light(0xfff8e7,1.85,-4,8,5);
light(0xfff6db,.65,3,5,-4);
light(0xffffff,.23,4,1,4);

function group(parent,name,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  g.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const character=group(scene,'character-golden',-.38);
const colors=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.96});
const color=hex=>new THREE.Color(hex);
const mix=THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const sm=THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep;
const gold=color(0xc69b39);
const shadeGold=color(0xad7633);
const highGold=color(0xdac04e);
const bellyIvory=color(0xe8d4a0);
const ochre=color(0xc08e40);
const charcoal=color(0x494131);
const fingertip=color(0x352e22);
const vec=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);

function profile(parent,name,rows,paint){
  const rail=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(rows.map(r=>vec(r[1],r[0],r[2])),false,'catmullrom',.43);
  const axis=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(rows.map(r=>vec(r[3]||0,r[0],r[4]||0)),false,'catmullrom',.43);
  const pos=[],rgb=[],idx=[];
  const bands=92,sides=80;
  for(let j=0;j<=bands;j++){
    const p=rail.getPoint(j/bands),o=axis.getPoint(j/bands);
    for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
      const a=(i%sides)/sides*Math.PI*2;
      const s=Math.sin(a),f=Math.cos(a);
      const x=o.x+s*Math.max(.001,p.x),z=o.z+f*Math.max(.001,p.z);
      pos.push(x,p.y,z);
      const c=paint(x,p.y,z,s,f);
      rgb.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(i<sides&&j<bands){
        const n=j*(sides+1)+i;
        idx.push(n,n+1,n+sides+1,n+1,n+sides+2,n+sides+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgb,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const normals=geo.attributes.normal;
  for(let j=0;j<=bands;j++){
    const a=j*(sides+1),b=a+sides;
    const n=vec(normals.getX(a)+normals.getX(b),normals.getY(a)+normals.getY(b),normals.getZ(a)+normals.getZ(b)).normalize();
    normals.setXYZ(a,n.x,n.y,n.z);
    normals.setXYZ(b,n.x,n.y,n.z);
  }
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,colors);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
}

const torso=group(character,'torso');
profile(torso,'rounded body',[
  [1.35,.001,.001,-.01,0],[1.44,.46,.36,-.02,0],[1.68,.77,.59,-.025,.015],
  [2.00,1.00,.79,-.015,.03],[2.39,1.12,.97,.005,.055],
  [2.76,1.14,1.03,.012,.065],[3.14,1.075,.96,.006,.064],
  [3.48,.975,.79,-.015,.05],[3.81,.887,.65,-.055,.005],
  [4.15,.843,.535,-.068,-.04],[4.44,.715,.456,-.064,-.045],
  [4.72,.565,.385,-.049,-.05],[4.97,.412,.29,-.021,-.05],
  [5.16,.325,.25,-.012,-.04],[5.23,.001,.001,-.012,-.04]
],(x,y,z,s,f)=>{
  const c=shadeGold.clone().lerp(gold,sm(y,1.4,3.2)).lerp(highGold,sm(y,3.52,4.66)*.78);
  const patch=Math.sqrt(((x-.035)/1.15)**2+((y-3.03)/1.04)**2);
  const mask=(1-sm(patch,.81,1.05))*sm(f,-.02,.50);
  const cream=ochre.clone().lerp(bellyIvory,sm(y,2.13,3.57));
  return c.lerp(cream,mask);
});

const legs=[];
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const leg=group(character,side<0?'leg-left':'leg-right',side*.355,1.73,-.035);
  legs.push(leg);
  profile(leg,'tapered leg',[
    [-2.11,.001,.001,-side*.079,.12],[-2.06,.198,.28,-side*.079,.105],
    [-1.92,.203,.28,-side*.073,.095],[-1.74,.218,.204,-side*.065,.015],
    [-1.36,.245,.222,-side*.033,0],[-.95,.283,.267,-side*.011,0],
    [-.54,.337,.323,side*.01,.005],[-.14,.396,.391,side*.006,.018],
    [.16,.321,.31,0,.016],[.24,.001,.001,0,0]
  ],(x,y,z,s,f)=>shadeGold.clone().lerp(ochre,sm(y,-1.9,.1)*.8).multiplyScalar(.87+.13*sm(s*side,-1,1)));
}

const head=group(character,'head',-.005,4.72,-.014);
profile(head,'rounded head',[
  [-.23,.001,.001,0,-.01],[-.16,.425,.303,0,-.013],
  [.03,.47,.357,.004,.005],[.25,.453,.366,.008,.011],
  [.45,.417,.339,.005,.008],[.617,.345,.284,-.003,-.008],
  [.735,.22,.192,-.014,-.014],[.802,.085,.081,-.02,-.021],
  [.82,.001,.001,-.022,-.023]
],(x,y,z,s,f)=>{
  const c=gold.clone().lerp(highGold,sm(y,.03,.69));
  const warmth=Math.exp(-((x/.34)**2+((y-.16)/.26)**2))*sm(f,0,.85);
  return c.lerp(color(0xb68841),warmth*.67);
});

function makeSweep(parent,name,paint,steps=36,sides=16){
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  const positions=new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array((steps+1)*sides*3),3);
  const rgb=[],indices=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=steps;j++){
    const c=paint(j/steps);
    for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){
      rgb.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(j<steps){
        const a=j*sides+i,e=j*sides+(i+1)%sides;
        indices.push(a,e,a+sides,e,e+sides,a+sides);
      }
    }
  }
  geo.setAttribute('position',positions);
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgb,3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,colors);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return knots=>{
    const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(knots.map(k=>vec(k[0],k[1],k[2])),false,'catmullrom',.44);
    const tangent=vec(0,0,0),p=vec(0,0,0),b=vec(0,0,0);
    const n=vec(0,0,0);
    for(let j=0;j<=steps;j++){
      const t=j/steps,u=t*(knots.length-1),k=Math.min(Math.floor(u),knots.length-2);
      curve.getPoint(t,p);
      curve.getTangent(t,tangent);
      if(j===0) n.set(tangent.y,-tangent.x,0).normalize();
      n.addScaledVector(tangent,-n.dot(tangent));
      if(n.lengthSq()<.0001) n.crossVectors(tangent,vec(0,1,0));
      n.normalize();
      b.crossVectors(tangent,n).normalize();
      const r=mix(knots[k][3],knots[k+1][3],u-k);
      const depth=mix(knots[k][4]??1,knots[k+1][4]??1,u-k);
      for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){
        const a=i*2*Math.PI/sides;
        const c=r*Math.cos(a),s=r*depth*Math.sin(a);
        positions.setXYZ(j*sides+i,p.x+n.x*c+b.x*s,p.y+n.y*c+b.y*s,p.z+n.z*c+b.z*s);
      }
    }
    positions.needsUpdate=true;
    geo.computeVertexNormals();
    geo.computeBoundingSphere();
    geo.computeBoundingBox();
  };
}
function sweep(parent,name,knots,paint,steps,sides){
  makeSweep(parent,name,paint,steps,sides)(knots);
}
const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,32,22);
function ellipsoid(parent,name,hex,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz){
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(sphere,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:hex,roughness:.86}));
  mesh.name=name;
  mesh.position.set(x,y,z);
  mesh.scale.set(sx,sy,sz);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const eyes=group(head,'eyes');
const expressions=[];
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const eye=group(eyes,side<0?'eye-left':'eye-right',side*.246,.415,.281);
  eye.rotation.y=side*.51;
  eye.rotation.z=side*.10;
  const closed=group(eye,'closed-lid');
  ellipsoid(closed,'lid',side<0?0xc8ac51:0xbca04c,0,0,.008,.108,.058,.026);
  sweep(closed,'lid crease',[
    [-.098,.009,.016,.001],[-.073,-.014,.028,.010],
    [-.016,-.028,.036,.011],[.049,-.022,.029,.009],[.093,.005,.016,.001]
  ],()=>color(0x988342),20,12);
  const open=group(eye,'open-eye',0,0,.018);
  ellipsoid(open,'green eye rim',0x849940,0,0,.010,.134,.147,.043);
  ellipsoid(open,'iris',0x4a8a56,0,0,.039,.102,.116,.029);
  ellipsoid(open,'pupil',0x070d0a,-side*.009,-.003,.061,.069,.087,.021);
  ellipsoid(open,'catchlight',0xafc4a7,-.024,.033,.077,.016,.019,.006);
  expressions.push({closed,open});
}

const mouth=group(head,'mouth',.011,.170,.362);
function buildMouth(smiling){
  const shape=group(mouth,smiling?'smile':'relaxed-mouth');
  const corner=smiling?.043:.000;
  const middle=smiling?-.013:.009;
  sweep(shape,'mouth line',[
    [-.201,corner,-.031,.001],[-.143,mix(corner,middle,.65),-.008,.012],
    [-.055,middle,.004,.015],[.038,middle,.005,.014],
    [.13,mix(corner,middle,.62),-.008,.012],[.201,corner,-.032,.001]
  ],()=>color(0x716137),30,12);
  sweep(shape,'lower lip',[
    [-.149,.000,-.012,.001],[-.076,middle-.019,.005,.010],
    [.011,middle-.023,.008,.012],[.092,middle-.017,.002,.009],[.151,.000,-.014,.001]
  ],()=>color(0xc89d4e),24,12);
  return shape;
}
const relaxed=buildMouth(false);
const smile=buildMouth(true);

function makeArm(side){
  const left=side<0;
  const arm=group(character,left?'arm-left':'arm-right',side*.61,4.29,-.09);
  const poseArm=makeSweep(arm,'rounded arm',t=>highGold.clone().lerp(ochre,sm(t,.25,.84)).lerp(charcoal,sm(t,.83,1)*.93),48,24);
  const hand=group(arm,left?'hand-left':'hand-right');
  sweep(hand,'palm',[
    [0,.09,0,.066,.75],[0,-.01,.013,.092,.73],
    [.004,-.13,.034,.127,.60],[.006,-.23,.046,.103,.55],[.012,-.279,.049,.006,.8]
  ],t=>charcoal.clone().lerp(fingertip,t*.44),24,22);
  const digits=[
    ['little finger',-.094,.175,-.035],['ring finger',-.034,.268,-.014],
    ['middle finger',.029,.294,.009],['index finger',.093,.237,.042]
  ];
  const fingers=[];
  for(const [name,x,len,spread] of digits){
    const finger=group(hand,name,x*(left?1:-1),-.183,.042);
    fingers.push({joint:finger,spread:x*(left?1:-1)});
    const dx=spread*(left?1:-1);
    sweep(finger,'finger',[
      [0,.016,0,.038,.90],[dx*.45,-len*.36,.012,.034,.95],
      [dx,-len*.75,.039,.026,1],[dx*.83,-len*.96,.065,.016,1],
      [dx*.74,-len,.071,.002,1]
    ],t=>charcoal.clone().lerp(fingertip,t*.76),23,14);
  }
  const thumb=group(hand,'thumb',left?.086:-.086,-.075,.039);
  const s=left?1:-1;
  sweep(thumb,'thumb',[
    [0,.014,0,.05],[s*.043,-.066,.023,.041],[s*.066,-.153,.061,.034],
    [s*.061,-.205,.085,.020],[s*.052,-.222,.092,.002]
  ],t=>charcoal.clone().lerp(fingertip,t*.65),24,14);
  return {arm,hand,poseArm,fingers,thumb,side};
}
const arms=[makeArm(-1),makeArm(1)];

const period=5540;
const times=[0,800,1530,2330,3130,3930,4670,5470,5540];
// Body position, scale, yaw, lean, head tilt, eyes, smile, and foot motion.
const bodyTrack=[
  [-.38,0,1,0,0,0,0,.15,0],
  [-1.04,-.19,.955,.32,-.028,.035,1,.80,.13],
  [-.55,-.15,.978,-.07,.008,-.035,1,1,-.13],
  [-.23,-1.04,1.29,.025,.002,.025,1,0,.02],
  [-.43,-.06,1.037,-.12,.019,-.025,1,1,.09],
  [-.05,-.06,.995,-1.46,.061,-.035,1,.42,-.16],
  [.20,-.06,.992,-1.56,.041,-.020,.96,.35,.12],
  [.22,.015,.994,-1.65,.059,.045,.76,.16,-.04]
];
// Elbow and wrist in a camera-aligned frame, followed by hand angle, pitch, roll and curl.
const leftTrack=[
  [-.95,3.35,-.13,-1.25,2.19,0,-.35,0,0,0],
  [-.61,3.40,.57,.34,4.53,1.14,2.22,-.28,.10,.38],
  [-.81,3.46,.37,-.67,4.12,.94,-2.79,-.12,.12,.05],
  [-1.00,3.08,.06,-1.54,2.17,.19,-1.30,.02,-.15,.08],
  [-.84,3.74,.49,-.68,3.67,1.20,-2.42,-.60,-.17,.03],
  [-1.11,3.77,-.44,-1.93,4.12,-.32,-1.46,1.03,.12,.08],
  [-1.29,3.66,-.45,-2.13,4.00,-.40,-1.35,.91,.05,.08],
  [-.16,2.94,-.60,.13,1.60,-.58,.22,.03,.22,.30]
];
const rightTrack=[
  [.93,3.35,-.13,1.17,2.05,0,.40,0,0,0],
  [.85,3.70,.33,.81,4.46,.97,-2.28,-.43,-.30,.49],
  [1.16,3.31,.07,1.55,3.47,.14,1.67,.44,.05,.19],
  [.91,3.33,-.22,1.24,1.90,-.19,.43,-.04,.13,.23],
  [1.00,3.17,-.13,1.23,1.84,-.10,.34,.05,0,.03],
  [-1.14,3.75,.67,-1.39,4.68,.71,-3.05,-.27,.42,.57],
  [-1.22,3.64,.66,-1.68,4.27,.77,-2.68,-.20,.29,.51],
  [.12,2.99,.72,.48,1.64,.64,.60,-.10,.18,.15]
];
for(const track of [bodyTrack,leftTrack,rightTrack]) track.push(track[0]);

const yAxis=vec(0,1,0);
const handEuler=new THREE.Euler(0,0,0,'ZXY');
const rotation=new THREE.Quaternion();
const undoYaw=new THREE.Quaternion();

function sample(track,i,u){
  return track[i].map((v,k)=>mix(v,track[i+1][k],u));
}
function poseLimb(limb,pose){
  const {arm,hand,poseArm,fingers,thumb,side}=limb;
  const e=vec(pose[0],pose[1],pose[2]).applyQuaternion(undoYaw).sub(arm.position);
  const w=vec(pose[3],pose[4],pose[5]).applyQuaternion(undoYaw).sub(arm.position);
  const shoulder=vec(side*.10,-.03,0);
  const upper=shoulder.clone().lerp(e,.46);
  const fore=e.clone().lerp(w,.43);
  const lower=e.clone().lerp(w,.72);
  poseArm([
    [0,.18,0,.026],[shoulder.x,shoulder.y,shoulder.z,.224],
    [upper.x,upper.y,upper.z,.204],[e.x,e.y,e.z,.159],
    [fore.x,fore.y,fore.z,.133],[lower.x,lower.y,lower.z,.111],
    [w.x,w.y,w.z,.083]
  ]);
  hand.position.copy(w);
  handEuler.set(pose[7],pose[8],pose[6],'ZXY');
  rotation.setFromEuler(handEuler);
  hand.quaternion.copy(undoYaw).multiply(rotation);
  for(const {joint,spread} of fingers){
    joint.rotation.x=-pose[9]*1.28;
    joint.rotation.z=spread*(.32-pose[9]*2.4);
  }
  thumb.rotation.x=-pose[9]*.70;
}

function render(t){
  const time=((t%period)+period)%period;
  let i=0;
  while(time>=times[i+1]) i++;
  const linear=(time-times[i])/(times[i+1]-times[i]);
  const u=mix(linear,linear*linear*(3-2*linear),.86);
  const [x,y,scale,yaw,lean,tilt,openness,grin,step]=sample(bodyTrack,i,u);
  character.position.set(x,y,0);
  character.scale.setScalar(scale);
  character.rotation.set(0,yaw,lean,'ZYX');
  undoYaw.setFromAxisAngle(yAxis,-yaw);
  const sideView=Math.abs(Math.sin(yaw));
  torso.scale.z=1+.24*sideView;
  torso.position.z=-.10*sideView;
  head.position.set(-.005,4.72,.11*sideView-.014);
  head.rotation.set(tilt,.055*sideView,-lean*.45);
  legs[0].rotation.set(step,0,-step*.26);
  legs[1].rotation.set(-step,0,step*.22);
  for(const {closed,open} of expressions){
    open.visible=openness>.14;
    closed.visible=openness<=.14;
    open.scale.y=Math.max(.06,sm(openness,.10,.9));
  }
  smile.visible=grin>.55;
  relaxed.visible=!smile.visible;
  mouth.scale.x=mix(.89,1.04,grin);
  poseLimb(arms[0],sample(leftTrack,i,u));
  poseLimb(arms[1],sample(rightTrack,i,u));
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[character],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body>
</html>
